name: TaskNest
tagline: A student planner that works offline
role: Solo developer: product design, architecture, development, testing and deployment
description: TaskNest helps students organise coursework, side projects, jobs and personal goals in one place. It works instantly and offline because data lives on the device first, and it syncs across phone and laptop in real time when logged in. Features include natural-language quick add, a calendar with time-blocking, a focus timer with idle detection, and an XP and streak system designed so it can’t be gamed.
features: Offline-first: works without internet and installs as an app (PWA)
Real-time sync across devices, with conflict handling and an account for each user
Natural-language quick add: “Lab report fri 5pm #lab !high ~1h” becomes a fully filled-in task
Calendar with a deadlines view, a class/meeting schedule, drag-to-time-block and .ics import/export
Focus timer that pauses when you’re idle, with no screen recording
Cheat-proof gamification: XP, levels, weekly streaks and 12 achievements, with anti-farming rules
Daily capacity planner, weekly review and 8-week insights
Templates, CSV/Todoist import, JSON backups with snapshots, keyboard shortcuts and a command palette
